</BottomSheet>

import { BottomSheet, Button, Input, Stack } from '@design-schema/rn';

<BottomSheet
  open
  heading="New expense"
  footer={<>
    <Button label="Save" variant="primary" />
    <Button label="Cancel" variant="secondary" />
  </>}
  height="full"
  dragToDismiss={false}
>
  <Stack gap="loose">
    <Input label="Description" name="description" />
    <Input label="Amount" name="amount" />
    <Input label="Date" name="date" />
  </Stack>
</BottomSheet>
